spans.s: सेन a. (f. ना) Having a lord, possessing a master or leader.
सेन a. (f. ना) Having a lord, possessing a master or leader.
सेना f. 1. Army, स सेनां महतीं कर्षन् पूर्वसागरगामिनीम् R.iv.32; 2. the wife of Kārtikeya, the god of war (?). (See देवसेना and the reference given there).
सेना-अग्र n. the front of an army.
सेना-अग्र˚ग m. the leader of an army.
सेना-अंग n. a component part of an army; (they are four- हस्त्यश्वरथपादातं सेनांगं स्याच्चतुष्टयम्).
सेना-चर m. 1. a soldier; 2. a sutler, a camp-follower.
सेना-निवेश m. the camp of an army.
सेना-नी m. 1. a leader of an army, a commander, a general, सेनानीनामहं स्कंदः Bg.x.24; 2. an epithet of Kārtikeya, अथैनमद्रेस्तनया शुशोच सेनान्यमालीढमिवासुरास्त्रैः R.ii.37, Kir.xv.7.
सेना-पति m. 1. a general; 2. a name of Kārtikeya.
सेना-परिच्छद् a. surrounded by an army.
सेना-पृष्ठ n. the rear of an rmy.
सेना-भंग m. the breaking of an army, rout, disorderly flight.
सेना-मुख n. 1. a division of an army; 2. a mound in front of a city gate.
सेना-योग m. the equipment of an army.
सेना-रक्ष m. a guard, a sentinel.
